'''2007 Yavin 4 Regionals Jared Napolitano DS Executor: Holotheatre''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jared Napolitano]] at [[2007 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Executor: Holotheatre|Dagobah-D-executorholotheatre-decipher-archive.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Hunt Down
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
